message: Hi mom, I will be home around 6:30 for dinner tonight. Love you!
Reminder: Your dental cleaning is scheduled for Tuesday Oct 28 at 2:00 PM. Reply 1 to confirm.
Hey team, the sprint retro notes have been uploaded to the wiki. Let me know if anything is missing.
Your library books are due back in 3 days. Renew online through your member dashboard.
Happy birthday Sarah! Hope you have a wonderful day celebrating with family.
The weather forecast predicts light rain tomorrow morning. Remember your umbrella.
Thanks for attending our community workshop on urban gardening. We hope you enjoyed it!
Can you review the attached draft when you get a chance? No rush, sometime this week is fine.
Flight UA 452 has landed at gate B14. Baggage is arriving at carousel 3.
Thank you for dining at Bistro Garden. Your server was Alex. Receipt #48291.
Good morning! Just confirming our 10 AM coffee meetup at the corner cafe.
The soccer match starts at 4 PM this Saturday. Don't forget orange slices for the team.
Your prescription is ready for pickup at Main Street Pharmacy.
Notice from City Water: Routine maintenance scheduled for tomorrow between 1 AM and 3 AM.
Hey Dave, do you have that recipe for the vegan chili we made last winter?
Congratulations on passing your certification exam! Great accomplishment.
School bus route 14 is running approximately 10 minutes late due to traffic.
Your grocery pickup order is being packed and will be ready between 5 PM and 6 PM.
Don't forget to submit your timecard before Friday noon for the biweekly pay cycle.
Thank you for supporting public radio. Your annual tax receipt is ready.
Looking forward to seeing everyone at the neighborhood potluck on Sunday afternoon.
